concerns.text: The plan references the NIST Corrosion Database (NIST‑IR‑8200) but does not provide a verified programmatic URL or a 'Verified Datasets' block. According to the constitution’s Verified Accuracy principle, every external dataset must be cited with a reachable URL. Add a proper citation (e.g., a DOI or stable download link) or include a Verified Datasets section with the canonical source.

The plan mentions retrieving alloy composition data from the Materials Project API (https://materialsproject.org) (FR‑019) but does not include a formal citation or URL for this source. Provide a verified citation for the Materials Project API to satisfy the Verified Accuracy requirement.
